 Ramayana movie release date: Check show timings, ticket prices in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata
 SECTIONS Ramayana movie release date: Check show timings, ticket prices in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Kolkata ET Online Last Updated: Nov 03, 2026, 02:25:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Ranbir Kapoor's eagerly awaited film Ramayana is set to debut on November 5, 2023, following global screenings. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the epic movie boasts a staggering budget of Rs 4000 crore. With ticket prices differing by location, format, and showtime, viewers can experience this cinematic masterpiece in 2D, 3D, IMAX, or 4DX, starting with early morning shows across major Indian cities.
 In Delhi, Ramayana's early morning shows begin at 6:00 AM. (Image - Agencies) All eyes are on Ranbir Kapoor ’s magnum opus Ramayana. After its Los Angeles and London world premieres, the Nitesh Tiwari-directed movie is finally ready to intrigue audiences on the big screen on November 5. Reportedly made on a budget of Rs 4000 crore, Ramayana will be released in both 2D and 2D formats, alongside large formats such as IMAX, 4DX, ScreenX, and Dolby. So, as the day of the premiere fast approaches, here’s a look at the ticket prices and show timings.
 Ramayana show timings and ticket prices
 Delhi 
Early morning shows begin as early as 6:00 AM at major multiplex chains, with additional early bird shows starting shortly after at 7:15 AM, as per BookMyShow. 
Ticket pricing peaks at the highest tier with 4DX 3D screenings , priced between Rs 1,100 and Rs 1,500 at premium outlets. Ticket prices for IMAX 3D format tickets range from Rs 900 to Rs 1,300.
3D tickets range from Rs 400 to Rs 750. 2D format screenings occupy the lowest, starting from Rs 200 up to Rs 400 for morning shows.
 Mumbai 
 Early morning shows kick off at 6:30 AM with the highest ticket bracket belonging to 4DX 3D shows, rated between Rs 1,200 and Rs 1,600. IMAX 3D tickets sell for Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,400.
 Standard 3D tickets are available between Rs 450 and Rs 800. Meanwhile, the 2D morning tickets range from Rs 250 to Rs 450.
 Bengaluru 
Early morning shows start at 6:15 am with 4DX 3D experiences, costing between Rs 1,000 and Rs 1,400. Meanwhile, IMAX 3D shows are priced from Rs 850 to Rs 1,250.
3D tickets fall somewhere between Rs 350 and Rs 650, and regular 2D shows start from Rs 180 to Rs 350.
 Kolkata 
Early shows begin at 7:00 AM and the premium price tier, led by 4DX 3D screenings, ranges from Rs 900 to Rs 1,300. The prices of IMAX 3D tickets are between Rs 750 and Rs 1,100.
Meanwhile, the prices of 3D format tickets are between Rs 300 and Rs 550, with the lowest prices being for 2D shows, spanning from Rs 150 to Rs 300.
